overview: SelTDA teacher (VQG) variant crt-plus-round1-final. C-RT+ GRPO teacher (w_vqa=0.5, clip-flant5-xl). Final after HRP rollback to best. mean_reward~1.02.
usage:
## Checkpoint

Load with SelTDA scripts; see version notes in model description.

```bash
python generate_questions.py --overrides pretrained=<path>   # teacher
python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=1 train_vqa.py --overrides pretrained=<path>  # student
```
